hypothesis: Same-parent LLM rewrites should share phishing logit independent of superficial style
training_objective: weighted original+rewrite supervised BCE + lambda/2 mean((logit_rewrite-logit_orig)^2) + 0.0008/2 L2
source_partition: N05 train only; no validation/test parent in training
limitations: External corpus already inspected repeatedly; cross-source model ranking exploratory and cannot establish SOTA or unseen generalization
LLM rewrites may change phishing meaning; no human semantic adjudication
Lexical evidence proxies are not verified security metadata
Prior contrastive consistency and evidence fusion work exists; novelty is unproven
Any failed D2 phishing recall or high external FPR must be reported as failed mitigation
